title: Home Assistant Automation Failures
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=automation_triggered
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(result="failed" OR level="ERROR")) as failures by automation
| eval fail_rate=round(100*failures/runs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - fail_rate
description: Counts how often each Home Assistant automation runs and how often it errors, so a broken automation surfaces instead of just silently not happening.
value: A failed automation is invisible by design — the lights just do not turn on; tracking failure rate makes these silent failures actionable.
implementation: Forward Home Assistant logbook/automation events to HEC; schedule hourly and alert when a key automation starts failing.
visualization: Table of automations by failure rate with a trend line.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when your home's automatic routines stop working, like lights that should have come on but did not.
